input.quote: (a) Cooperation on Termination. On its resignation or termination, the Servicer will cooperate with the Issuer, the Owner Trustee, the Indenture Trustee and the Successor Servicer in effecting (i) the termination of its rights and obligations under this Agreement and (ii) an orderly transition of such rights and obligations to the Successor Servicer.
input.rationale: A usable exit/transition regime exists and, on its material terms, sits at or above the preferred position, so we do not redline it. Section 7.3 requires Cellco as Servicer to keep performing until a Successor Servicer accepts its engagement (or the date stated in the termination notice) — i.e. transition assistance of unlimited rather than 6-month duration — and Section 7.5(a) adds an express cooperation obligation for an orderly transition. Section 7.5(b) requires transfer of all funds and delivery of the Receivable Files and the accounts and records maintained by the Servicer to the Successor Servicer, and Section 3.10(f) requires the same of Cellco as Custodian; Section 7.5(c) puts all reasonable transition expenses on the resigning or terminated Servicer, which is better than the playbook's "then-current rates" and clearly benefits us. Minor sub-elements short of the model wording, noted but not flagged: delivery is "as soon as practicable" rather than within a fixed 30 days, no specified machine-readable format, and no deletion certification (unsurprising here, since the underlying obligor data is Cellco's own customer data that it must retain to service the wireless accounts). The p0346 carve-out (no obligation to license processes, models or servicing software, or to provide items restricted by confidentiality or privacy/data protection policies) narrows the assistance but does not defeat the mandatory delivery of the Receivable Files and records; p0338 and Exhibit A contemplate that information will in fact flow to a Successor Servicer that agrees to be bound by those policies. Nothing approaches the walk-away of no data return or immediate deletion.
